description: This source file defines the React component InstantPage, which displays a list of instant-delivery products with features like discount badges, wishlist toggles, add to cart, quick buy, and navigation to product details. It fetches product data asynchronously, manages UI state for loading and errors, and integrates with various services and context providers.

methods.name: InstantPage()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the instant delivery products page with fetching logic, user interaction handlers, and dynamic UI elements.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Handles adding a product to the shopping cart after verifying user is logged in.

methods.name: quickBuy
methods.description: Handles quick purchase process and redirects to checkout after verifying user login.
